entries.title: Dark theme hairlines follow the light-mode scale
entries.source: issue #285 (dashboard/setup screenshots); `tokens-dark.less` previously mapped `--el-border-color-extra-light` to `--color-gray-400`
entries.revisit_when: another page still has dominating chrome after this token change, or Element Plus starts shipping a first-class dark theme we adopt

entries.title: Dark current-page chip is fill plus light text
entries.source: issue #285 current-menu highlight; PR review of the `#2563a8` + orange pairing
entries.revisit_when: the dark sidebar palette is retuned

entries.title: Election-stage chips use fill tokens, not light-only white
entries.source: issue #285; `StageControl.vue` had `#fff` / `#dcdfe6` / `#606266`
entries.revisit_when: stage chips gain a selected-outline treatment that needs its own token

entries.title: Names use `--color-text-link`, not `--el-color-primary`
entries.source: issue #285 names-list contrast; People table uses `el-button type="primary" link`
entries.revisit_when: primary solid buttons also need a lighter dark fill

entries.title: Leftover screens use the same tokens (Front Desk / voter / profile / join)
entries.source: issue #285 follow-up after PR #354; local hex on Front Desk filters, voter elections/ballot, Profile QR, Teller join, CardSkeleton, tie cards
entries.revisit_when: a designer pass restyles dark chrome, or another page still shows a light-only surface

entries.title: Warning banners and leftover fills use semantic tokens
entries.source: issue #285 follow-up after PR #356; AppSidebar / LandingPage had a `:root.dark` hex override that did not cover LanguageFlagsSelector or the sidebar status link
entries.revisit_when: a designer pass restyles warning chrome, or warning-700 on warning-50 drops below WCAG AA

entries.title: Branch badge and audit muted dashes use shared tokens
entries.source: issue #285 follow-up after the warning/fill/inverse slice (`81eda682`); `App.vue` `.bottomCorner` was `#f0f0f0` / `#666`; Audit Logs `.text-muted` was `#909399`
entries.revisit_when: a designer pass retunes small chrome, or Element Plus official `dark/css-vars.css` is adopted
